set.body: Add continuous parcel-field expansion to image support with explicit background, plus a versioned parcel metric schema retaining parcel domain identity, key ordering, value type/schema and provenance. Reuse existing image/locus operations and atlas publication identity; platform IO adapters remain outside shared computation. Acceptance: keyed round trips reject foreign domains or tampering, categorical labels remain unchanged, independent expansion fixtures and JVM/JS shared schema tests pass.
set.title: Atlas: expand and persist typed parcel metrics
